headline: MTN Nigeria Blames Device Settings for Accelerated Mobile Data Consumption
summary: MTN Nigeria attributed rapid subscriber data depletion to unoptimized smartphone background settings and automatic app updates rather than network-level metering errors.
why: MTN Nigeria is the country's biggest mobile telecommunications network and a key revenue driver for parent company MTN Group.

impacts.name: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc
impacts.why: Clarifying billing disputes eases subscriber churn risks while mobile data remains the core growth driver.
